statement: Kepler Compute is marketing a new memory technology offering capacity beyond SRAM and HBM for inference, backed by $468M raised, with sampling in 2026 and production in 2027.
why: A funded challenger to HBM aimed at inference is a possible future relief valve for the memory bottleneck that currently caps accelerator output, though nothing ships in volume before 2027.

impact.mechanism: An alternative high-capacity memory path, if it reaches production, adds non-HBM supply for inference systems and reduces the degree to which accelerator shipments are gated by HBM allocation.

confidence.basis: Company's own marketing site, secondary tier; claims are unaudited and the headline capacity multiple is explicitly not stated on the page.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: keplercompute.com (company site)
